text.text: Read it, run it, challenge it.
All our expertise, written into open methods. Eleven skills, one per question an investor has to answer, each a document you can read in ful
Scroll to watch a memo get built.
The main trunk of the method has five stages, from the market to the first 100 days. Supporting skills feed them with cohorts, interviews an
A first-principles view of the market, then a sourced deep dive: sizing, value chain, players, M&A and the five trends that matter.
Demand is moving from point tools to platforms in the mid-market.
A two-page memo: financials or proxy signals, ownership, founders, an evidence-backed SWOT.
Fed by customer and expert interviews
Founders hold a majority and the digital leader reports to the CEO.
Does it grow? What breaks at 10x?
Retention, adoption, red flags and a verdict: Invest, Conditional or Pass.
Fed by cohort analysis, a user panel and interviews
Retention flattens after the ninth month.
Does the tech back the claims?
A six-axis scorecard on the same verdict scale, checking what the product story could only claim.
The uptime guarantee is claimed but missing from the customer contract.
Sized levers, a 100-day plan, the metrics that prove it worked and the board asks.
Lever one: cut time to first value, and prove it with one metric.
Three rules make a memo defensible. They are written into the method, and the platform enforces them in code.
